BiblicalUsage: Sholtan is dominion, the rule of a kingdom, and Daniel uses it for the only dominion that lasts. Nebuchadnezzar confesses that God's dominion is from generation to generation, Darius decrees that men tremble before the God of Daniel whose dominion has no end, and the vision promises the kingdom and the dominion to the people of the saints of the Most High.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every empire is on loan. Daniel watched dominions rise and fall, and I hold that only God's dominion is everlasting, so I will not fear the ones that pass.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
